articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
articles.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

articles.title: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
articles.description: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.

articles.title: Makers of GLP-1 drugs ordered to add warnings about rare eye condition that can lead to blindness
articles.description: The US Food and Drug Administration says Ozempic, Wegovy, and other weight-loss drugs must have labels about the condition, known as NAION.

articles.title: Ex-investigator admits depriving war crimes probe of potentially valuable information
articles.description: A former senior investigating officer for the Royal Military Police has admitted depriving a war crimes investigation of potentially valuable information.

articles.title: France blames Iran for massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges
articles.description: France has accused Iran of being behind the massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges last month.
